Class GameStage

java.lang.Object
models.stages.GameStage
Direct Known Subclasses:
China, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Vietnam
public abstract class GameStage extends Object
Abstract base class for all game stages (levels).

A GameStage owns the enemy-spawn schedule, the enemy-tower HP, and the stage's background image. The game loop calls updateStage(ArrayList, double) every frame; subclasses implement spawnEnemyLogic(ArrayList) to define the stage's unique wave patterns using frameCount as a timer (60 ticks ≈ 1 second).

    • updateStage

      public void updateStage(ArrayList<Unit> units, double currentHp)
      Called once per game-loop frame. Increments frameCount and delegates to spawnEnemyLogic(ArrayList) for wave scheduling. Also keeps enemyTowerHp in sync with the live tower value.
      Parameters:
      units - the active unit list (enemies are added here)
      currentHp - the enemy tower's current HP this frame

    • spawnEnemyLogic

      protected abstract void spawnEnemyLogic(ArrayList<Unit> units)
      Stage-specific enemy-spawn logic, driven by frameCount. Implementations create enemies, add them to units, and register them with BattleManager so cat units can find them as targets.
      Parameters:
      units - the live unit list to which new enemies are added
